item.title: Dry Enough to Close? Measuring Construction Moisture in Timber Buildings Under TEK17
item.description: TEK17 § 13-14 says timber must be dry when it is built in. What the rule says, what Norwegian CLT projects show, and a measure-before-close protocol.

item.title: A Renovation Passport Before the Rules Arrive: Planning Staged Upgrades for Norwegian Buildings
item.description: The EU's 2024 buildings directive introduces renovation passports. Norway has not adopted it yet. Here is what a passport contains, and how to plan staged upgrades in the right order today.

item.title: Seven Checks Before Your BIM Model Becomes a TEK17 Climate Account
item.description: A BIM model is not a climate account. Seven practical checks on scope, layers, thin materials, reinforcement, rounding, simplified objects and data sources before TEK17 §17-1 reporting.

item.title: The Material Passport Is Not a Reuse Permit: Building a Verified Second-Life Record
item.description: A digital material passport can improve traceability, but it cannot certify reuse. The evidence, testing and decisions a recovered building component needs before its second life.
